claims.content: To enable the Operator to monitor and display the status of all system field elements so that any change in device state is reported on the screen.

goal.raw_text: To enable the Operator to monitor and display the status of all system field elements so that any change in device state is reported on the screen.

claims.content: Operator
The Operator is logged on to the RLCS, and the number of logged-on users is within the limit of the number of users defined in the database.
The Operator’s access level and authorized workstation permit access based on the user’s access level and authorized workstations.
The current status for all devices is maintained at each controller unit.
Each device has one or more Alarm Criteria.
The monitoring frequency for the current mode is specified in the System Control Parameters.
The frequency specified in the System Control Parameters for that mode is reached.

trigger.raw_text: The frequency specified in the System Control Parameters for that mode is reached.

claims.content: At the frequency specified in the System Control Parameters for that mode, the system monitors the status of all field devices.
Monitor Devices 3.2.2.1 receives Device Sensor Status from RLCS Field Devices.
Monitor Devices 3.2.2.1 sends Device Sensor Status to Process GUI Commands 3.2.2.4.
Process GUI Commands 3.2.2.4 receives Command, Device Description, Device Sensor Status, and Security Level from Data Processing and Security 3.2.4.
The Operator performs a status check of All devices at All locations.
The Operator exchanges RLCS Status and Control with the RLCS.
1. During ‘degraded’ mode, the system monitors device sensors at the frequency rate stored in the database to take effect only during ‘degraded’ mode.

2. If an intermediate step resulted in a device control failure, Device Override allows an operator with the proper security to continue an operating sequence through to the end by allowing the operator to input a device status thereby overriding the status coming from the field.
3.2.2.4.2 Each device control command shall check the current status of all closure devices in the system and shall abort if any closure control device status is unknown. Exit: abort.

Track # of Failed Device Commands 3.2.2.5 receives Command Failure Count from Monitor Devices 3.2.2.1 and sends Command Data (for retry) to Control Devices 3.2.2.2. Exit: Command Data (for retry) sent to Control Devices 3.2.2.2.
The RLCS software has monitored, displayed, and updated the database with the status of all system field elements.
Any change in device state has been reported on the screen not later than 2 seconds from the time it occurs.
Each status received from device sensors has been checked against alarm conditions for that device sensor, and the status has been updated to indicate an alarm.
The current status for all devices is maintained at each controller unit.
Device sensor status is displayed using dynamic icons for all field device sensors and controllers.
The status check by Operator of All devices at All locations has been performed.
